title: Jensen’s Back, Now What?
text:
Jensen’s Back, Now What?

Laila Khawaja, Arthur Kroeber

Gavekal Technologies: Chips | 25 Nov 2026

Jensen Huang’s sudden reinstallation at Nvidia has once again scrambled the picture for the AI industry both in the US and China, and for efforts by China hawks in Washington to limit technology flows to China. We draw three main conclusions from this development. First, despite Huang’s return, the policy momentum on export controls remains with the hardliners. Second, the true impact of tighter export controls will depend on how strictly the Bureau of Industry and Security enforces them. Finally, Beijing will probably not respond forcefully to new restrictions (for now) so long as they focus mainly on closing loopholes in existing laws.
